summary: Hardcoded author Gemini API key in static HTML asset
details: The package ships a single index.html containing a Cloudflare-Worker-style fetch handler with a hardcoded Google Gemini API key, which forwards chat content to generativelanguage.googleapis.com. The package has no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare lifecycle scripts, and the declared main (index.html) is not a loadable Node module, so nothing executes on npm install or require(). The exposed key only consumes the author's own Gemini quota; there is no mechanism to redirect installer-supplied data, read installer secrets, or execute attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
